messages:
tara: quick sync 1 - tests show sampling before late enrichment can produce traces billed as unknown-tenant. Need quick pattern decision.

matt: can you show a tiny repro?

tara: repro: trace t1, span A has tenant, span B gets tenant via async KV after ingest, sampling happens before KV so B drops. Later rehydration loses tenant.

alex: options: pre-enrich at edge (p99 cost), push tenant token into SDK (long rollout), trace-level sampling, or keep tiny metadata envelope for dropped spans to stitch later.

samir: minimal envelope sounds pragmatic. What size & TTL?

alex: propose placeholder ~64 bytes (trace_id, inbound_ts, maybe experiment_id), TTL default 10s, configurable up to 60s per region.

matt: hybrid: only create placeholder when tenant missing to avoid global retention blowup. Gate via per-tenant config.

tara: metrics: placeholders_gauge, rehydrate_count, unknown_billing_count, histogram time_to_tenant. SLI: <=0.1% unknown for enterprise.

ingest-bot: deploy-job: placeholder-proto queued by matt at 2026-03-22T15:10Z

matt: action: I'll prototype gateway placeholder PR by EOW. alex: calc enterprise prefix-cache numbers. samir: add dashboards for placeholders + rehydrate. Tara: will file follow-up RFC if prototype looks good.

tara: thanks, closing for now. :thumbsup:
